summary: Completed testing of RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) module. Backend APIs (17/17 tests passed) and frontend Roles Management page fully functional. Fixed bug in Assign Role dialog where users weren't loading.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All features working after bug fix

seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed roles created and cleaned up during testing. Custom role 'Regional Manager' exists from previous API testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RBAC module complete with 47 permissions across 11 modules, 7 system roles + 1 custom role (Regional Manager). System roles can have permissions modified but cannot be deleted. Custom roles support full CRUD. User assignment works via Assign dialog.

backend_api_permissions.details: Returns 47 permissions grouped by 11 modules (User Management, Vendor Management, Buyer Management, RFQ Management, Quote Management, Order Management, Payments & Finance, WhatsApp, Analytics, Disputes, System Admin)

backend_api_roles_list.details: Returns 8 roles (7 system + 1 custom). include_base_roles param to filter base roles.

backend_api_role_crud.details: Create, update, delete custom roles. System roles can be updated (permissions only) but not deleted.

backend_api_role_assignment.details: Assign custom roles to users. DELETE /api/admin/roles/assign/{user_id} to remove.

backend_api_user_permissions.details: Returns current user's permissions based on base role + custom role

frontend_roles_page.details: Roles Management page accessible at /admin/roles. Shows role cards with name, description, permission count, System badge for system roles.

frontend_create_role_dialog.details: Create New Role dialog with name, color picker, description, and expandable permission modules with checkboxes.

frontend_edit_role_dialog.details: Edit Role dialog shows 'System role - only permissions can be modified' for system roles. Permission count badges (e.g., 4/5) shown for each module.

frontend_assign_role_dialog.details: Assign Role dialog lists all users with name, email, role badge, and Assign/Remove button. Search functionality works.

admin_sidebar_link.details: Roles link present in admin sidebar navigation

bugs_fixed.issue: Assign Role dialog showed 'No users found' because fetchUsers expected data.users but API returns array directly

api_endpoints_tested.response: { success, message } or 400 for system roles
